snippet.title: New Mobile Game "BanG Dream! Our Notes" Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The story of five bands begins with MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica.

The new mobile game "BanG Dream! Our Notes" will officially launch in 2026. Please look forward to it!
